verdicts.reason: A: "food & drinks" is split from "Order online" and sits on top of the box, so the "drinks" text collides with the carton. The headline shrinks to tiny text and ends up bigger-looking subordinate to the tagline. The two rules are far apart and frame nothing, and the message is fragmented. B: the lockup is kept together as in the original, with rules above and below, a bold headline and an italic subline, and it doesn't touch the image. Flaws: the text block is small for the wide banner and has a lot of dead space on the left, the cluster floats slightly right of centre in the empty area, and the tagline is small.
